equipment_type: Room controller (fan coil / VAV / chilled beam)
applies_to: Regin Regio RCX room controllers with firmware 2.1 (fan coil, radiator, chilled beam and VAV applications).
summary: Regio RCX is Regin's room controller family with RS485 that runs EXOline, Modbus or BACnet MS/TP. The variable list gives 327 BACnet objects: room measurements and outputs, controller state and mode, setpoints per state, remote (BMS) values for room temperature, CO2, humidity and airflow with enable selectors, manual/auto overrides for every output, raw I/O, alarms and display settings.
notes: Taken from Regin's variable list (xlsx), "Default BACnet name", "Object type", "Instance", "Unit" and "Writeable" columns; the same file lists the EXOline and Modbus addresses.

Names follow the variable list's "Default BACnet name" column. Regin's EDE zip for 2.1-1-01 (RCX file only) gives upper-case names for the same instances (for example AI1_VALUE for AV 1001 IoAnaIn_1_value, REG_CONTROLLERSTATE for MV 10001), leaves out 54 of these objects and puts many display objects on the same instance (11000), so the variable list is used.
Multistate state texts come from the RCX EDE state-text file (matched by instance or object name); the variable list does not print them.
Which outputs are in use depends on the configured application; unused output objects stay at 0.

integration.summary: Write MV 10051 RC_RemoteControllerState to set the controller state (off/unoccupied/standby/occupied/bypass) from the BMS, and the occupied heating/cooling setpoints (AV 10361 / AV 10391) or AV 10401 setpoint offset. Keep BV 9101 HeartbeatTrigger pulsing. Read MV 10001 RC_ControllerState, MV 10011 RC_ControllerMode, AV 10002 room temperature, AV 10081 active setpoint and BV 10271 sum alarm.

minimum_points.name: RC_RemoteControllerState
minimum_points.why: Controller state set from the BMS

minimum_points.name: HeartbeatTrigger
minimum_points.why: Write 1 periodically to stay in normal mode

integration.enable: MV 10051 RC_RemoteControllerState sets the state directly via communication; MV 10041 RC_ControllerStateDefault is the state used when nothing else controls it.
integration.heartbeat: BV 9101 HeartbeatTrigger must be written to 1 periodically to keep normal operation (the controller resets it to 0); MV 9301 RC_OfflineFunction sets what happens when the trigger stops (disabled, output defaults, application). MV 10081 RC_ControllerStateFail sets the controller state during communication faults. No timeout value is given in the list.
integration.remote_sensors: Each measured value has a remote copy and an enable BV: write AV 10611 RC_RoomTempRemote and set BV 10321 RC_RoomTempRemoteSelect to use a BMS room temperature; the same pattern covers CO2 (AV 10621 / BV 10331), airflow, changeover temperatures, supply air, humidity, VOC, damper position and the digital inputs.
setup: Port 1 (RS485) protocol, baud rate and format are MV 9001 / 9101 / 9201; write BV 9001 CommCommit = 1 to apply them.
gotchas: Manual/auto select objects (…ManSelect) left on Manual keep an output fixed; BV 10311 RC_AlarmManualOutput flags it.
Setpoints and configuration are stored values; do not write them cyclically.
